description.value: Breakwater Bistro & Bar is a full-service oceanfront restaurant perched on Dallas Road in Victoria, overlooking the Salish Sea and the Olympic Mountains with the Breakwater Lighthouse path right at its doorstep. The complex includes a café/bistro, a Tasting Room available for private events, and Overboard Ice Cream — an in-house small-batch creamery with dairy-free and vegan flavours. A Cafe To-Go counter lets hungry cyclists grab coffee and pastries without sitting down.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 34m; stands (4 spaces) at 67m. Total: 4 spaces.
